SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS pending,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS settled,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS hit,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (2,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS lost,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS push_count,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS full_win,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS full_loss,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS half_win,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS half_loss,
ROUND( 100.0 * SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / NULLIF( SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ), 2 ) AS hit_rate,
ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN r.rate ELSE NULL END ), 2 ) AS avg_rate
FROM football_ai_recommend_record r

SELECT DATE(r.match_time) AS stat_date,
COUNT(*) AS total,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS settled,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS hit,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (2,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS lost,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS push_count,
ROUND( 100.0 * SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / NULLIF( SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ), 2 ) AS hit_rate,
ROUND(AVG(r.rate), 2) AS avg_rate
FROM football_ai_recommend_record r
GROUP BY DATE(r.match_time) ORDER BY stat_date ASC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(r.market, ''), '未知') AS code, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.market, ''), '未知') AS label,
COUNT(*) AS total,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS settled,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS hit,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (2,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS lost,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS push_count,
ROUND( 100.0 * SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / NULLIF( SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ), 2 ) AS hit_rate
FROM football_ai_recommend_record r
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.market, ''), '未知')
HAVING SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) > 0
ORDER BY hit_rate DESC, settled DESC

SELECT bucket_code AS code, bucket_label AS label, COUNT(*) AS total,
SUM( CASE WHEN result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS settled,
SUM( CASE WHEN result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS hit,
SUM( CASE WHEN result_status IN (2,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS lost,
SUM( CASE WHEN result_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS push_count,
ROUND( 100.0 * SUM( CASE WHEN result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / NULLIF( SUM( CASE WHEN result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ), 2 ) AS hit_rate
FROM ( SELECT r.result_status,
CASE WHEN r.rate < 80 THEN 'lt80' WHEN r.rate < 85 THEN '80_85' WHEN r.rate < 90 THEN '85_90' WHEN r.rate < 93 THEN '90_93' WHEN r.rate < 95 THEN '93_95' WHEN r.rate < 98 THEN '95_98' ELSE '98_100' END AS bucket_code,
CASE WHEN r.rate < 80 THEN '80以下' WHEN r.rate < 85 THEN '80-85' WHEN r.rate < 90 THEN '85-90' WHEN r.rate < 93 THEN '90-93' WHEN r.rate < 95 THEN '93-95' WHEN r.rate < 98 THEN '95-98' ELSE '98-100' END AS bucket_label
FROM football_ai_recommend_record r
) x
GROUP BY bucket_code, bucket_label
ORDER BY FIELD( bucket_code, 'lt80', '80_85', '85_90', '90_93', '93_95', '95_98', '98_100' )

SELECT r.model AS code,
CASE WHEN r.model = 'jiebao' THEN '捷报模型' WHEN r.model = 'nami' THEN '纳米模型' ELSE r.model END AS label,
COUNT(*) AS total,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS settled,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS hit,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (2,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS lost,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS push_count,
ROUND( 100.0 * SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / NULLIF( SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ), 2 ) AS hit_rate,
ROUND(AVG(r.rate), 2) AS avg_rate
FROM football_ai_recommend_record r
GROUP BY r.model ORDER BY hit_rate DESC, settled DESC

SELECT result_code AS code, result_label AS label, COUNT(*) AS total FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN r.result_status = 3 THEN 'push' WHEN r.result_status IN (1,4) THEN 'hit' WHEN r.result_status IN (2,5) THEN 'lost' ELSE 'pending' END AS result_code,
CASE WHEN r.result_status = 3 THEN '走水' WHEN r.result_status IN (1,4) THEN '命中' WHEN r.result_status IN (2,5) THEN '未命中' ELSE '待结算' END AS result_label
FROM football_ai_recommend_record r
) x
GROUP BY result_code, result_label
ORDER BY FIELD( result_code, 'hit', 'lost', 'push', 'pending' )

SELECT bucket_code AS code, bucket_label AS label, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS settled, SUM(CASE WHEN result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hit, ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF( SUM(CASE WHEN result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0 ), 2 ) AS hit_rate FROM ( SELECT r.result_status, CASE WHEN r.rate < 80 THEN 'lt80' WHEN r.rate < 85 THEN '80_85' WHEN r.rate < 90 THEN '85_90' WHEN r.rate < 93 THEN '90_93' WHEN r.rate < 95 THEN '93_95' WHEN r.rate < 98 THEN '95_98' ELSE '98_100' END AS bucket_code, CASE WHEN r.rate < 80 THEN '80以下' WHEN r.rate < 85 THEN '80-85' WHEN r.rate < 90 THEN '85-90' WHEN r.rate < 93 THEN '90-93' WHEN r.rate < 95 THEN '93-95' WHEN r.rate < 98 THEN '95-98' ELSE '98-100' END AS bucket_label FROM football_ai_recommend_record r
) x GROUP BY bucket_code, bucket_label ORDER BY FIELD( bucket_code, 'lt80','80_85','85_90','90_93','93_95','95_98','98_100' )

SELECT r.sport AS code,
CASE WHEN r.sport = 'basketball' THEN '篮球' ELSE '足球' END AS label,
COUNT(*) AS total,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS settled,
SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS hit,
ROUND( 100.0 * SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) / NULLIF( SUM( CASE WHEN r.result_status IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ), 2 ) AS hit_rate
FROM football_ai_recommend_record r
GROUP BY r.sport ORDER BY total DESC
